summary: Join training on decentralization and local governance strategies. Learn to implement effective solutions that strengthen community engagement and leadership.
lede: Decentralization and local governance training helps public officials and governance practitioners shape workable local services. You learn to map responsibilities and funding across government levels, connect local plans and budgets to service delivery, and develop citizen participation and accountability approaches. The course also covers intergovernmental coordination and assessing risks as reforms are implemented.
audienceIntro: This course is tailored for those involved in designing and implementing decentralization and local governance strategies.
audience: Local government leaders (mayors, council members, chief
Program and project managers in NGOs
Planners and service delivery managers in sectors
Community development and citizen engagement practitioners
modules: Foundations of Decentralization and Local Governance
Legal, Policy, and Institutional Frameworks for Local Government
Roles, Mandates, and Functional Assignment Across Levels of Government
Fiscal Decentralization and Local Revenue Mobilization
Local Development Planning and Service Delivery
Risk, Politics, and Change Management in Decentralization
Monitoring, Evaluation, and Learning in Local Governance Reforms
prerequisites: Participants are expected to have a foundational understanding of government operations and basic project management skills. Prior experience in public administration or development projects will be beneficial.
